QuestInfo.name: Aquarium Winter Preparations
QuestInfo.0: Kenta in Aquarium has a request regarding winter preparations for the animals at the Zoo.
QuestInfo.1: Kenta thinks that the land animals are not adapting to the sea's cold winter. He wants you to get Warm Bubbles from the bottom of the sea.
QuestInfo.2: You delivered the Warm Bubbles that Kenta requested for the animals at the Zoo. Kenta was very happy that he could keep the animals warm through the winter.

0.0: Oh, the one from above the sea! Hello. Work at the zoo doesn't get less busy even during winter. It's always crazy around here. The animals from above the sea get agitated, since they're not used to winter under the sea. I would like to do something for them.  Would you help me?

yes.0: It's warmer here than on the land, but it's still relatively cold. And the humidity tends to bother many of the animals. The Warm Bubbles that rise from the undersea volcano is the animals' favorite since they're warm and cozy. Please bring me #e#b20 Warm Bubbles#k#n, which you can get from the monsters in the ocean.\n\n#b#i4032569# #t4032569# x 20

no.0: I just want to comfort the animals, but I can't do it alone.  I feel so sorry for them...
